title: ToyOS build proof must come from a successful container build
symptom: ToyOS build evidence could look active on the host while the production audit still treated the artifact as non-real or build-proof missing.
root_cause: Host-side wrapper execution can fall back into Windows-native tool resolution and emit misleading failure logs; the audit only becomes trustworthy after a fresh successful build run that produces build-report.json, build/build.log, build/kernel.bin, and artifact.sha256 with newer mtimes.
fix: Use the Docker-managed ToyOS build image when host toolchain availability is uncertain.
Require a successful build report plus fresh kernel and checksum artifacts before claiming ToyOS is a real product artifact.
Re-run artifact_audit after the build to confirm products_real and focus_artifact_real are updated from live evidence.
validation: docker run --rm -v D:\codex:/codex -w /codex/generated/toy-os-demo toyos-managed-toolchain bash -lc 'python3 /codex/orchestrator-mvp/tools/build_toy_os.py --target /codex/generated/toy-os-demo --managed-backend docker'
python -m tools.artifact_audit => products_real: 1, focus_artifact_real: true, focus_artifact_valuable: true
